frontmatter.title: SaiLoR Architecture
frontmatter.description: Deep dive into SaiLoR's architecture — the Tauri shell (renderer vs Rust process split), why the web SPA runtime was discontinued (desktop-only now), the PlatformAdapter seam over the SlrBridge/Tauri transport, the split project.json + annotations/ on-disk storage format, the four Zustand stores, the Zustand store with undo/redo (incl. PDF marks), reading-position persistence, the component tree, multi-reviewer consolidation with stored alignment, git integration (the Rust shell spawns git), the src-ta

frontmatter.title: SaiLoR Quickstart
frontmatter.description: Entry-point guide to SaiLoR, a Tauri 2 desktop tool for conducting Systematic Literature Reviews (SLRs). Covers what SaiLoR is, the split project.json + annotations/ storage format, the current tech stack (React 19, Tauri 2 + Rust shell, Vite 6, Zustand+immer, Zod, react-pdf), quick-start commands, the repository layout, and a task-routing map to the right wiki page for common change areas.

frontmatter.title: SaiLoR Developer Documentation
frontmatter.description: Home page for SaiLoR developer documentation. SaiLoR 2.0 is a Tauri desktop tool for conducting Systematic Literature Reviews (SLRs), storing the annotation schema and paper metadata in project.json and each reviewer's/consolidation's annotation data in a sibling annotations/ folder. Links to quickstart, architecture, data model, and operations pages.

frontmatter.title: Knowledge Graph View
frontmatter.description: How SaiLoR builds a graph from papers, authors, venues, keywords and answers, lays it out in a worker, filters it with depth queries or a Cypher subset with hard limits, folds the node list into a side drawer, and exports it as JSON-LD, Turtle, GraphML or CSV.

frontmatter.title: Progressive Project Loading
frontmatter.description: How SaiLoR opens large split projects as a head plus batches of paper files, the loadState and generation guards in the Zustand store, retry on a failed batch, and why saving and whole-project features wait until loading ends.

frontmatter.title: Annotation Schema and Validation
frontmatter.description: How a hand-authored schema in project.json becomes a typed, validated annotation form — AnnotationDef/ResolvedDef types, zod validation, field types, cardinality, visibleIf gates, the schema editor's draft lifecycle, required/enum/type/cardinality checks, orphaned-answer recovery, schema-version moves, completeness, and duplicate detection.

frontmatter.title: AI-Assisted Annotation
frontmatter.description: How a reviewer invokes an LLM to pre-fill annotation fields from one paper or a whole batch — the provider abstraction, the four run modes (prompt, agent with judge, classify with System One, re-check), budgeting and retry, the aiStore batch loop with review and apply, and the security invariant that an API key never lives in the renderer.

frontmatter.title: Multi-Reviewer Consolidation
frontmatter.description: How multiple reviewers' independent annotation trees are aligned by optimal entry matching (align.ts + maxWeightAssignment, similarity metrics), compared field by field through the stored alignment, and reconciled into a single consolidated tree — covering the useConsolidationAlignment scheduler and its consolidationSync gate, growing/freezing/widening the tree, readiness checks, inter-rater statistics, batch unanimous adoption, and the disagreement/export surface.

frontmatter.title: Result view diagrams
frontmatter.description: How the Diagrams tab of the Result view turns annotation answers into bar, stacked, line, pie and heat-map charts in a worker, and exports them as SVG, PNG, vector PDF (with an optional embedded system font) or CSV.

frontmatter.title: Online Demo and Project Site
frontmatter.description: How the compile-time DEMO_MODE build, the in-memory demo adapter, the schema-editor demo mode and the bundled demo PDFs work, and how the static project site plus the demo are built and deployed to GitHub Pages.

frontmatter.title: Local Models and Ollama
frontmatter.description: Running LLMs fully offline — the app-managed llama.cpp runtime and hash-verified decision-model downloads, hardware probing and backend selection, the guided setup panels, and connecting to a user-run Ollama or OpenAI-compatible local server.

frontmatter.title: PDF Viewer and Marks
frontmatter.description: The PdfViewer component (react-pdf/pdf.js), zoom/navigation/search, text-selection capture for field-grabbing, internal-link hover previews, PDF marks (highlights/comments with undoable mutations), field-linking marks to annotation fields, mark export (burning marks into real PDF annotations in the Rust shell), reading-position persistence, the slr-file:// serving contract, PDF folder scan and rescan, the demo's no-PDF notice, and PDF metadata/text extraction.

frontmatter.title: Tauri Shell, IPC and Self-Update
frontmatter.description: The Rust desktop shell of SaiLoR 2.x — the TauriAdapter transport and its channel-to-command mapping, the session authorization model, the slr-file PDF protocol, LLM key handling, and the signed self-update flow.

frontmatter.title: AI-Assisted Screening
frontmatter.description: The aiScreeningStore flow for proposing one Include/Exclude decision per paper from title+abstract (or a PDF excerpt), with a prompt engine and a System One classify engine, human review before anything is written, and threshold-gated pre-ticking.

frontmatter.title: Testing Strategy
frontmatter.description: The four test layers and how to run them — Vitest unit tests, the real-git jsdom integration suite, Rust unit tests in src-tauri, and the tauri-driver e2e probe — plus the wiki-link check, the reproducible git-scenario rig, and what CI gates on.

frontmatter.title: Git Integration
frontmatter.description: The git workflow end to end — clone-to-import, the commit/pull/push/branch-switch panel, merge-branch, the field-level three-way merge at the heart of conflict resolution, the changes parser, the security gates, concurrent revision reads, the gitStore state machine, and the Rust shell (`src-tauri/src/git.rs`) that owns the only path to git, merge preview with backup refs and Undo last merge, and the stash flows.

frontmatter.title: Project Data Model
frontmatter.description: The on-disk split-file project format and the in-memory TypeScript types behind it — the load → normalize → edit → prune → serialize lifecycle, the per-paper-per-reviewer annotation file layout, schema-version renames and moves, legacy single-file migration, and the five-state annotation vocabulary.

frontmatter.title: Screening Mode
frontmatter.description: The screening workflow — a fast Include/Exclude decision per paper before annotation begins — covering the derived two-node schema, the tri-state status read, PRISMA-style counts, cross-field validation, the screening UI panels, the on-disk screening-* filename prefix, the screening highlights carried into the next project, and importing a screening project into an annotation project.
